designSystem: Padrão Digital de Governo (gov.br Design System)
scope: Initial normalized rules for Button, List, Modal, Table, iconography and development flow
Expanded rules for component keyboard behavior and content constraints
Initial typography reference and grid measurements
WCAG mappings and validator templates for indexed eMAG recommendations
Expanded component coverage for Header, Upload, Pagination, Radio, Select, Textarea and Wizard
Structural signatures for 172 canonical component examples
Template Base and Template Error rules
Static accessibility and CDN audit of official package HTML examples
WAI-ARIA and semantic HTML validator guidance
knownLimitations: The research interface did not provide full HTML snapshots or client-side browser execution.
Code examples, complete design tokens, e-MAG, templates and release history remain incomplete.
Seeded component URLs must be verified individually against the current stable site.

officialPackage.name: @govbr-ds/core
officialPackage.author: SERPRO (http://serpro.gov.br/)
officialPackage.preservationPolicy: O arquivo do pacote não é redistribuído no corpus. São armazenados hashes, metadados, tokens e assinaturas estruturais dos exemplos.
